FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 61
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 01/21/2026
REVISED
Senate Bill 61 as introduced would increase the obligations of: (1) the Alabama Medicaid
Agency, by an agency-estimated minimum of $4 million in state share dollars, to redetermine
eligibility monthly for certain Medicaid benefit recipients pursuant to the provisions of this bill;
and (2) the Alabama Department of Human Resources (DHR), by an agency-estimated
minimum of $12.7 million, to redetermine eligibility monthly utilizing the new eligibility
requirements for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and for the anticipated
increase in determining eligibility by prohibiting DHR from granting categorical eligibility for
SNAP benefits.
In addition, this bill could decrease enrollment in SNAP by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of households receiving SNAP benefits based upon categorical eligibility that
may no longer qualify for the SNAP benefits.
